ic_device.name: LM393B, LM2903B, LM193, LM293, LM293A, LM393, LM393A, LM2903, LM2903V
ic_device.description: Dual independent voltage comparators designed to operate from a single power supply over a wide range of voltages, with open-collector outputs.

port_dependencies.condition: Comparator 1 output responds to differential voltage between 1IN+ and 1IN-
Comparator 1 output responds to differential voltage between 1IN+ and 1IN-
Comparator 2 output responds to differential voltage between 2IN+ and 2IN-
Comparator 2 output responds to differential voltage between 2IN+ and 2IN-

functional_blocks.name: Comparator 1
functional_blocks.description: Compares differential voltage between 1IN+ and 1IN- and outputs logic low or high impedance on 1OUT.

functional_blocks.name: Comparator 2
functional_blocks.description: Compares differential voltage between 2IN+ and 2IN- and outputs logic low or high impedance on 2OUT.
